contexts.text: All the kings of Media () ... where the desolation of the Spiritual Church is treated of; of which Church the differences are mentioned in order, and are signified by Media, etc.
The like is afterwards meant in (Dan. 8) by the kings of Media and Persia, as by the ram...

By the Mede () are meant those who are against the truths and goods of the Church; and therefore it is said of them, who shall not esteem silver, nor be delighted with gold... AE 357:17. ( = those who make nothing of the truth and good of the Church, and destroy those things which are thence of understanding and love. AE 710:24.) AE 724:15.
By the Mede is not meant the Mede; but such persons and such things in the Church as devastate it.
